yt_description:
Ever wondered how computers sort massive amounts of data? 🤔 Let's dive into Selection Sort, one of the most intuitive sorting algorithms! We'll visualize step-by-step how it finds the smallest element and places it in its correct position. Perfect for beginners and a great refresher for coding pros! ✨

🚀 What you'll learn:
- The core logic of Selection Sort
- Visual walkthrough with animated examples
- Time complexity explained (O(n^2) ⏱️)
- When to (and when NOT to) use Selection Sort
